parsed.result_reading: The robot fell in all 4 seeds (2 forward, 2 backward) after a median upright time of 3.25 s. Mean forward velocity was slightly backward (-0.005 m/s) and ended more backward (-0.037 m/s). Step frequency was high at 4.41 Hz (healthy 2.57-3.88 Hz) while step length was short at 0.117 L (healthy 0.157-0.231 L). Pitch mean was negative (-0.038 rad, backward lean) and pitch rate mean negative (-0.267 rad/s). COM was behind the centre of pressure (com_ahead_of_cop_over_L_mean = -0.061) and the capture point lay outside the support interval (capture_margin_over_L_mean = -0.259). Angular momentum was negative (-0.012, backward rotation). Friction utilisation was high (p95 = 0.707 vs healthy 0.169-0.336) despite low slip. These symptoms indicate excessively rapid, short steps with insufficient forward trunk lean and excessive knee flexion, leading to unstable forward/backward falls.
